desc: Derive pairwise visibility condition: answer = max over pairs j<i of (H_j·X_i − H_i·X_j)/(X_i − X_j), clamped at 0; -1 if max < 0.
Correct geometry: maximizing pair is NOT a global upper-hull edge (counterexample sample 4: pair (1,2) gives 120/7); per building i, tangent point on lower hull of predecessors minimizes slope(j,i).
Choose exact integer arithmetic for comparisons (cross-multiplication, B > 0 always) to avoid precision issues.
Implement corrected sweep: lower hull of predecessors with integer cross-product pops; binary search tangent (unimodal slope sequence) per building; track max intercept as fraction; O(N log N).
Handle output edge cases: print "-1" exactly when max intercept < 0 (incl. N=1); print 0.000... when max is exactly 0; use %.18f otherwise.
Verify against all four samples and edge cases (N=1, collinear points, tall first building).
